from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

out = Path('hera_scratch')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 9))
records = []
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    channels = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    cc = current_channel(channels)
    vc = next(c for c in channels if c.cid == 'sr1')
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    I = r.col(cc.col) / cc.gain
    V = r.col(vc.col) / vc.gain
    R = np.abs(V / I)
    order = np.argsort(B)
    B, R = B[order], R[order]
    records.append((rid, B, R))
    ax[0,j].plot(B, R, lw=.9)
    ax[0,j].set(ylabel='Raw |Vxx / I| (ohm)', xlabel='B setpoint (T)', title=f'Run {rid}: B_1 - B_2')
    ax[1,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), I*1e9, label='drain (nA)')
    ax[1,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e9, label='TG (nA)')
    ax[1,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e9, label='BG (nA)')
    ax[1,j].legend(); ax[1,j].set(xlabel='B setpoint (T)', ylabel='Current (nA)')
    ax[2,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col('sr0_P'), label='sr0')
    ax[2,j].plot(r.col('magnet_field'), r.col('sr1_P'), label='sr1')
    ax[2,j].legend(); ax[2,j].set(xlabel='B setpoint (T)', ylabel='Phase (deg)')
    print(f'run {rid}: rows {r.rows}, interrupted={r.interrupted}, R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm, I={I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA, max |Vxx|={abs(V).max()*1e6:.3f} uV, T={r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K')
    print('max abs leakage pA:',*[float(abs(r.col(c)).max()*1e12) for c in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr')])
    print('acquisition', {inst: {p: r.meta['instruments'][inst]['snapshot']['parameters'].get(p,{}).get('value') for p in ('amplitude','sensitivity','time_constant','filter_slope','nplci')} for inst in ('sr0','sr1','k_2400_tg','k_2400_bg')})
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/'spots_raw.png', dpi=130); plt.show()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,7))
for j, (rid, B, R) in enumerate(records):
    for lo in (1., 1.5, 2.):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:,None], B, b_range=(lo,8.), nfft=4096)
        ax[0,j].plot(f, spec[0]/spec[0].max(), label=f'{lo:g}-8 T')
        peaks,_ = find_peaks(spec[0], prominence=.08*spec[0].max())
        print(f'run {rid}, FFT {lo:g}-8 T peaks:', sorted([(round(float(f[k]),2),round(float(spec[0,k]/spec[0].max()),2)) for k in peaks if f[k]<70],key=lambda p:-p[1])[:10])
    ax[0,j].set(xlim=(0,65),xlabel='Frequency (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT',title=f'Run {rid}'); ax[0,j].legend()
    try:
        onset=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=.3,r_full_scale=5000.)
        print(f'run {rid}:',onset.summary())
        for tone in onset.tones:
            ax[1,j].plot(tone.b_centers,tone.snr,label=f'{tone.freq:.1f} T')
        ax[1,j].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':'); ax[1,j].legend()
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f'run {rid}: onset unresolved: {e}')
    ax[1,j].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Matched-filter SNR')
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/'spots_sdh.png',dpi=130); plt.show()

**Read / decision (plan step 4):** data/6 and data/7 are complete, unclipped: peak |Rxx| 530 and 587 Ω, drain 9.843–9.935 and 9.809–9.931 nA, maximum absolute gate currents 0.123 and 0.216 nA. Sample T spans 1.165–1.292 K. Electron FFT peaks persist near 7, 22, and 30 T across 1–8, 1.5–8 and 2–8 T windows; they are not an established count of bands (harmonics, nonlinear resistance, and spatial inhomogeneity can all contribute). The hole peak structure changes substantially with the window. Electron phases wrap near voltage zeros; phase there cannot establish an independent band.

The onset helper returns an electron lower edge of 0.30 T, censored and sensitive to the background and near-zero resistance; do not interpret this as a measured SdH die-off. The hole headline onset is ~0.71 T. A fan that follows branches across density is the next discriminating measurement. Acquire both carrier signs, with low-field context rows and resolved inverse-B sampling from 1.25 to 6 T. Retain raw gate axes and test secondary-CNP replicas before a stacking assignment.

**Calibration qualification:** the run-5 resistance-minimum origin is a provisional operational D≈0, not a unique proof of electrostatic zero. The two ridges suggest differing local neutrality conditions; their microscopic origin and separate stackings are not measured. Neither a gaplike rise with D nor these spot spectra yet establishes ABAB, ABCA, or ABCB.

## HERA — bipolar Landau fan for the stacking call (plan step 4)

> **05:23** · Bipolar Landau fan: B 0 to 6 T, 107 rows; nominal n -1.2 to +3.2e12 at D~0, 89 points; Si 0 V; base T; 3 s dwell · **ETA ~15:53** (≈10h30m)

Runs 6/7 show oscillations on the sole connected B_1–B_2 pair, steady 9.81–9.94 nA drain current, ≤0.216 nA absolute gate currents and peak |Rxx| 530/587 Ω. The electron spectrum has ~7, 22 and 30 T components, but harmonics and the secondary CNP of run 5 make a band-count inference premature. This fan tracks the branches across both carrier signs and both neutrality features; raw gate axes remain authoritative because run 5 fixes the capacitance ratio but leaves the absolute scale geometry-anchored and D=0 a resistance-symmetry proxy.

**Coverage and resolution:** nominal n_A −1.2..+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² at operational D≈0, 89 points (0.05×10¹² increments); TG −0.277033..+0.983594 V, BG −0.465040..+1.166281 V, Si fixed 0 V. Four context rows at B=0,0.5,0.75,1 T precede 103 rows uniform in 1/B from 1.25 to 6 T: Δ(1/B)=0.006209 T⁻¹, <0.23 cycles per row for F≤37 T. The lower context rows do not resolve high-density oscillations; at 1.25 T the nominal fourfold density period has only ~2.4 samples, improving to ~11.6 at 6 T. This first fan resolves the moderate-field branch pattern; a low-field fine fan remains conditional on what appears. The small density tails to the D≈0 operating-box edges (approximately −1.27 and +3.27) are omitted; extending them would add ~20 min. Extending 6→10 T at the same inverse-B spacing adds roughly 3 h, deferred until branch visibility warrants it. Negative field and other D lines are not covered.

**Acquisition and price:** after read-only preconditions check the handoff state, set sr1 to 100 µV (10 kΩ nominal full scale) because state0 restored 2 µV. Leave both lock-ins at τ=0.3 s / 24 dB/oct and use 3 s per point (10τ); retain gate steps and Si ramp rate. Run 5 measured 1.098 s/point with 1 s dwell and NPLC=1; budget 3.2 s/point here for dual-gate motion and extra readbacks. 9,523 points cost ~8.5 h, the 0→6 T ramp floor is 6×7.3=43.8 min, plus flybacks, 3 s magnet settles, row freshness checks and contingency. Finish at 6 T to avoid a wasted return traverse.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first B=0 row against the session's zero-field data, then the 0.5/0.75 T rows for drain loss, leakage, clipping and phase anomalies; inspect the hera-watch digest at least every 30 min thereafter, with a branch-visibility decision near 2 T. Continue only if the measured channels remain sound; an unresolved pattern at the first few low-B rows alone is not a wash-out. All followed channels have live plots. Point guards stop for >1 nA gate current, drain outside 5–15 nA, >90% lock-in full scale, T/freshness failure or setpoint/readback mismatch. On safety failure, notify and drop E0. **VTI-specific:** a kernel interrupt does not stop an active magnet ramp; the supply continues to its current row target. Re-read actual state after any stop; operator action at the supply is required to halt that ramp.

# Plan step 4: bipolar D~0 Landau fan; all instrument calls stay in measure.
# Preconditions first; no instrument writes until every check below passes.
import json
from pathlib import Path
from hera.analysis import field_invB
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

def _fan_expect(label, actual, expected, ok):
    print(f'{label}: actual={actual}; expected={expected}')
    assert ok, f'FAN PRECONDITION FAILED: {label}'

for _p, _limits in (
    (k_tg.volt, (-0.3, 1.0)), (k_bg.volt, (-1.3, 2.0)),
    (dc205.smart_voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)), (dc205.voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)),
    (magnet.field, (-10.0, 10.0)),
    (heater.sample_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0)), (heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0)),
):
    _actual = (float(_p.vals._min_value), float(_p.vals._max_value))
    _fan_expect(_p.full_name+' validator', _actual, _limits, _actual == _limits)
_fan_expect('session caps', (B_SESSION_CAP,T_SESSION_CAP), (10.,100.),
            (B_SESSION_CAP,T_SESSION_CAP) == (10.,100.))
for _name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(_name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_fan_expect('sample temperature K', _Ts, '1.0..1.5', 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5)
_fan_expect('vaporizer temperature K', _Tv, '<1.6 and within 0.6 of sample',
            0 < _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv-_Ts) < .6)
_fan_expect('handoff field T', _B, '|B|<0.03', abs(_B) < .03)
_ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_fan_expect('heater ranges', _ranges, (0,0), _ranges == (0,0))
_ps = (magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled())
_fan_expect('magnet switch/output', _ps, (True,True), all(_ps))
_si = (dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output(), k_si(), dc205.ramp_rate)
_fan_expect('Si range/output/V/ramp_rate', _si, '(2,1,0,0.5)',
            _si[0] == 2 and _si[1] == 1 and abs(_si[2]) < .01 and _si[3] == .5)
_gate_state = (k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step,k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
_fan_expect('handoff TG/BG V, steps, NPLC', _gate_state, '(0,0,.005,.005,1,1)',
            abs(_gate_state[0]) < .001 and abs(_gate_state[1]) < .001 and _gate_state[2:] == (.005,.005,1.,1.))
_wiring_expected = {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
                    'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
_fan_expect('hardwired contacts', WIRING, _wiring_expected, WIRING == _wiring_expected and 'mux' not in globals())
_drive = (sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
_fan_expect('drive V/Hz', _drive, '(1.0,13.777)', abs(_drive[0]-1.) < 1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<.01)
_acq = {name: {'tau':obj.time_constant(), 'slope':obj.filter_slope(), 'sensitivity':obj.sensitivity()}
        for name,obj in (('sr0',sr0),('sr1',sr1))}
_fan_expect('lock-in tau/slope', _acq, 'both 0.3 s / 24 dB per octave; sr0 20 mV',
            all(a['tau']==.3 and a['slope']==24 for a in _acq.values()) and _acq['sr0']['sensitivity']==.02)
_fan_expect('channel gains/bias', (meas_config['sr0_gain'],meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1.),meas_config['bias_resistor'],meas_config['bias_channel']),
            '(-1e6,1,1e8,sr1)', meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1.)==1.
            and meas_config['bias_resistor']==1e8 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1')

# Explicit calibration avoids the stale geometry-only `cal` from setup.
FAN_CAL = dict(c_tg=.0027960593093052633, c_bg=.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-.08937933224099137, D_offset=-.013)
n_fan = np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,89)  # nominal 1e12 cm^-2; absolute scale provisional
Vtg_fan,Vbg_fan = calc_gate_voltages(n_fan,0.,**FAN_CAL)
B_fan = np.r_[0.,.5,.75,1.,field_invB(1.25,6.,103)]
for _p,_vec in ((k_tg.volt,Vtg_fan),(k_bg.volt,Vbg_fan),(magnet.field,B_fan)):
    for _v in _vec:
        _p.validate(float(_v))
print(f'FAN GRID: {len(B_fan)} x {len(n_fan)} = {len(B_fan)*len(n_fan)} points; '
      f'TG {Vtg_fan.min():+.6f}..{Vtg_fan.max():+.6f} V; BG {Vbg_fan.min():+.6f}..{Vbg_fan.max():+.6f} V; '
      f'B {_B:+.4f}->6 T; bare ramp floor {(6-_B)*7.3:.1f} min')

# Restore useful headroom after state0 replay (which restored sr1 to 2 uV).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
_fan_expect('sr1 sensitivity V',sr1.sensitivity(),.0001,sr1.sensitivity()==.0001)
_acq['sr1']['sensitivity']=sr1.sensitivity()
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':_si[2], 'sample_temperature:':_Ts, 'sr1_gain':1.,
           'fan_calibration':FAN_CAL, 'density_scale':'geometry anchored, provisional',
           'D_origin':'run 5 resistance-minimum proxy, provisional',
           'acquisition_readback':_acq, 'comments':'landau-fan: bipolar operational D~0; B 0..6 T; Si 0; base T'})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc, basedir=str(Path(main_dir)/'data'))
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2; n_A nominal -1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (89, step .05); D proxy 0 V/nm; '
              'B context 0,.5,.75,1 T then 103 inverse-B rows 1.25..6 T; TG -0.277033..0.983594 V, '
              'BG -0.465040..1.166281 V; Si 0 V; 3 s fast + 3 s row dwell; '
              'sr1 100 uV, tau .3 s/24 dB; run-5 calibration; gates retain .005 V pacing')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(Vbg_fan[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(Vtg_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
# Raw X is stored with gain=1; metadata carries physical preamp gains for analysis.
_followed = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,
             magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for _p in _followed:
    s.fp(_p)
    s.plot('time',_p)
_fan_index = {p.full_name:4+i for i,p in enumerate(_followed)}
_fan_guard = {'points':0, 'reason':None}

def _fan_check_after(station,data):
    def value(p):
        return float(data[_fan_index[p.full_name]])
    issues=[]
    if not np.isfinite(np.asarray(data,dtype=float)).all(): issues.append('nonfinite data')
    if abs(value(k_tg.curr))>1e-9 or abs(value(k_bg.curr))>1e-9: issues.append('gate leakage >1 nA')
    _idrain=value(sr0.X)/mc['sr0_gain']
    if not 5e-9 < _idrain < 15e-9: issues.append('drain outside 5..15 nA')
    if abs(value(sr0.X))>.9*_acq['sr0']['sensitivity'] or abs(value(sr1.X))>.9*_acq['sr1']['sensitivity']:
        issues.append('lock-in >90% full scale')
    if not 1.0 <= value(T_sample) <= 1.5 or not 0 < value(T_vaporizer) < 1.6:
        issues.append('base temperature failed')
    if abs(value(magnet.field)-float(data[1]))>.03: issues.append('field mismatch >30 mT')
    if abs(value(k_tg.volt)-float(data[2]))>.003 or abs(value(k_bg.volt)-float(data[3]))>.003:
        issues.append('gate readback mismatch >3 mV')
    # Check advancing worker files once per row; no extra instrument driver imports.
    if _fan_guard['points'] % len(n_fan)==0:
        try:
            for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as exc:
            issues.append(f'thermometry freshness: {exc}')
    _fan_guard['points'] += 1
    if issues:
        _fan_guard['reason']='; '.join(issues)
        print('FAN STOP:',_fan_guard['reason'],'B/TG/BG=',data[1:4],flush=True)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(_fan_check_after,())
try:
    fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[B_fan],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],
                               [Vtg_fan,Vbg_fan],slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
finally:
    print('FAN final readback:', {'B_T':magnet.field(),'TG_V':k_tg.volt(),'BG_V':k_bg.volt(),
          'Si_V':k_si(),'Ts_K':T_sample(),'Tv_K':T_vaporizer(),'guard_reason':_fan_guard['reason']},flush=True)
# No blind park: next field trajectory starts from this measured endpoint.

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing.
